# LOEME Quote

> LOEME Quote is a free, multilingual collection of practical cost calculators and quote tools for fabrication, local services, and independent work.

## About

LOEME Quote helps people turn job inputs into a cost breakdown, margin check, and customer-ready quote. Available scenarios cover 3D printing, pressure washing, laser cutting, residential cleaning, house painting, freelance work, CNC machining, lawn care, and window cleaning.

Calculations and PDF or CSV generation run in the user's browser. Customer names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, company details, quote numbers, item names, notes, and other customer-related fields are not sent to or stored in the product analytics database.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://quote.loeme.com/): Overview of the cost calculator and quote tool library.
- [Tool library](https://quote.loeme.com/calculators): Available calculators by category.
- [3D Print Cost Calculator](https://quote.loeme.com/calculators/3d-print-cost-calculator): Calculate filament, machine time, electricity, labor, failure risk, margin, shipping, tax, and quote totals. Export PDF or CSV.
- [Pressure Washing Quote Calculator](https://quote.loeme.com/calculators/pressure-washing-quote): Estimate surface work, crew time, operating costs, minimum charges, and margin.
- [Laser Cutting Cost Calculator](https://quote.loeme.com/calculators/laser-cutting-cost-calculator): Estimate sheet material, waste, machine time, setup, handling, finishing, quantity, and margin from manual CAD/CAM statistics.
- [Cleaning Quote Generator](https://quote.loeme.com/calculators/cleaning-quote-generator): Estimate cleaner-hours, labor, overhead, supplies, travel, add-ons, minimum fees, and margin for residential cleaning.
- [House Painting Quote Calculator](https://quote.loeme.com/calculators/house-painting-quote): Build a house painting quote from paintable area, coats, coverage, paint waste, material cost, labor production, surface condition, overhead, minimum fee, margin, and tax.
- [Freelance Job Quote Calculator](https://quote.loeme.com/calculators/freelance-job-quote): Price a freelance project from scope hours, revisions, rush premium, fixed costs, margin, minimum fee, and tax.
- [CNC Machining Cost Calculator](https://quote.loeme.com/calculators/cnc-machining-cost-calculator): Estimate a 3-axis CNC milling batch from material, programming, setup, machine time, inspection, tooling, finishing, margin, and tax.
- [Lawn Care Quote Calculator](https://quote.loeme.com/calculators/lawn-care-quote): Price lawn service from mowable area, grass condition, crew production, labor, equipment, travel, add-ons, overhead, margin, and tax.
- [Window Cleaning Quote Calculator](https://quote.loeme.com/calculators/window-cleaning-quote): Price window cleaning from window types, service scope, access, condition, screens, tracks, crew time, supplies, travel, margin, and tax.
- [Pricing Guides](https://quote.loeme.com/guides): Practical job costing and quote guides.
- [Privacy](https://quote.loeme.com/privacy): Data boundary and analytics practices.

Pressure washing, laser cutting, residential cleaning, pricing guides, and guide articles are also available under each locale prefix. English remains unprefixed.

## Tool capabilities

- Multiple print items with editable quantity and material inputs.
- Scenario-specific inputs for fabrication and local services, including material, machine time, labor, operating costs, waste, failure risk, setup, handling, shipping, tax, margin, and minimum fees where applicable.
- Global currency selection with search and scrolling, including USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY, TWD, and other major currencies. Monetary inputs are converted when the selected currency changes and formatted with the currency's standard decimal precision.
- Physical unit switches convert the underlying area, rate, thickness, and length values where applicable instead of changing labels only.
- Local browser printing or PDF saving plus customer-ready CSV exports.
- Privacy-safe aggregate export events for product analysis; customer-related free text is excluded.

## Canonical guidance

Use the page language that matches the reader. English pages use unprefixed URLs; Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, German, Japanese, Spanish, French, Brazilian Portuguese, and Korean pages use their locale prefixes. Use the linked page content as the source of truth for current features and supported inputs.
